title: Lunkenheimer Lot Skatepark
subtitle: Redevelopment suggestion
role: MLA studio — client: Cincinnati Recreation Commission
summary: A skatepark redevelopment plan for the vacant Lunkenheimer lot in Cincinnati, designed in studio for a real client — the Cincinnati Recreation Commission: a bowl, a street course, a covered stage, and terraced seating set in planted edges, tested in plan and physical site models.

sections.heading: Suggestion
sections.body: An underused industrial lot reimagined as a neighborhood skatepark: bowl, street course, covered stage, and terraced seating in a planted plaza. Developed in studio for the Cincinnati Recreation Commission and tested through a stylized plan and physical site models.
